units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 107a:7">Snh. 107ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 11:1">Ps. XI, 1</cite>) <he>שלא יאמרו … צפור נְדַדְתּוֹ</he> lest they say, that mountain among you (David)—a bird has shaken it.
<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 10:1">Esth. R. to VI, 1</cite> <he>נָדְדוּ שמים כסאו וכ׳</he> the heavens shook the throne of &c.
<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 38:4">Sifré Deut. 38</cite> <he>ונוֹדֵד שנת וכ׳</he> and chases away the sleep of his eyes (watches constantly) over it; a. e.

<cite ref="Megillah 15b:20">Meg. 15ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Esther 6:1">Esth. VI, 1</cite>) <he>נָדְדָה שנת מלכו וכ׳</he> the sleep of the King of the world fled; <cite ref="Esther 6:1">ib.</cite> <he>נדדו עליונים וכ׳</he> those on high were agitated; <cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 50:7">Pirké d’R. El. ch. L</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Kamma 9:27">Tosef. B. Kam. IX, 27</cite> <he>ונדדה</he> and the tooth was loosened.—Part. pass. <cite ref="N00216"><he>נָדוּד</he></cite>; f. <he>נְדוּדָה</he>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Kamma 9:27">Ib.</cite> <he>היתה … שינו נ׳ וכ׳</he> (not <he>נדדה</he>) if his tooth had been loose, and he (the master) caused it to fall out; <cite ref="Kiddushin 24b">Kidd. 24ᵇ</cite>; a. e.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 10a:14">B. Bath. 10ᵃ</cite> <he>שמְנַדְּדִין שינה מעיניהם</he> who chase the sleep from their eyes (study by night).
<cite ref="Ketubot 62a:6">Keth. 62ᵃ</cite> <he>שמְנַדְּדוֹת וכ׳</he> who keep themselves awake (while their husbands are studying); a. e.—
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 18">Lev. R. s. 18</cite>, v. <cite ref="N00234"><he>נִדְנֵד</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 571:3">Yalk. Lev. 571</cite> <he>ובלבד שלא תהא מִתְנַדֶּדֶת</he> provided it (the bench) be not shaken (when they sit on it).
